title: Lucia · Fine Art Print (2025)
caption: From “The Existentialist” Series — Manuel Cech
description_html: Lucia portrays the fragile balance between light and decay — a meditation on human endurance and identity. The work captures a quiet transformation, where emotion dissolves into stillness. Each print preserves the texture and tonal depth of the original pastel painting.

title: Mirror · Digital Artwork (2025)
caption: Existential Realism — identity, decay and transformation.
description_html: Mirror is a self-portrait study exploring erosion, memory and the thin line between presence and absence.
